{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for only email and paid_search channels (though already confirmed)
filtered_df = df[df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
cov_rate_email = filtered_df[filtered_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
cov_rate_paid_search = filtered_df[filtered_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

difference = cov_rate_email - cov_rate_paid_search

cov_rate_email, cov_rate_paid_search, difference"}
